research_updates.title: Corrective candidate-modeling gate retains one threshold and rejects proxies
research_updates.notes: Every missing contribution category and county outcome was tested candidate by candidate. Investment: rejected allocation of Core Campus capital spending and the 2022 parcel transfer because no NAP7 phase allocation exists and a deed value is not new productive spend. Construction and suppliers: rejected multiplier, job-year and local-purchase-share models based on the $200,000 remodel permit because the administrative value is not audited expenditure and no completion, payroll, invoice, vendor geography or local-retention inputs exist. Operations: rejected floor-area, generator-count and company-job intensity models because no NAP7 roster, payroll, tenant mix or worker residence is observed. Fiscal: rejected annualization of the partial payment, abatement allocation and jurisdictional-receipt inference because future installments, personal-property accounts, benefit scope and distributions are unknown. Public costs: retained only the exact fiscal-year 2027 assessed-liability break-even identity equal to the $912,973.28 same-account bill; rejected any actual-cost or net-fiscal estimate because marginal fire, police, road, utility, administrative and infrastructure costs are absent. Resources: rejected generator-rating, emissions-limit, PUE and cooling-tower proxies because utilization, load, runtime, efficiency, cycles and meter data are absent. Community: rejected annualization or NAP7 allocation of the $3 million in-kind gift because timing, recurrence and building incidence are unresolved. County employment: rejected pre/post, matched-gap and difference-in-differences models because NAP4 predates NAP7, facility headcount is absent and the Great Recession, tourism cycle, COVID-19 and later Switch builds contaminate treatment timing. County GDP: rejected for the same non-identification plus the absence of a facility spending or output bridge. County wages: rejected because nominal county average weekly wages reflect inflation and industry composition while NAP7 payroll, occupations and residence are absent. A net fiscal model is therefore also rejected; the retained threshold is standalone, modeled, non-additive and makes no claim about actual cost, cash collection or fiscal surplus.

economic_scope_note: Reviewed evidence batches at campus or company/county scope. No record is allocated to an individual inventory building. Source checking establishes what a document reports, not an independent audit or causal attribution. Monetary figures are nominal. Peak workforce is distinct from annual employment; source-year labels do not establish fiscal-year boundaries. Original forecasts remain forecasts until realization is verified. No cross-record benefit total is defined. Cumulative project costs are not annual expenditure. Tax receipts and incentive payments remain separate, with inferred taxpayer links disclosed. Contextual research updates do not count as economic amounts. Account tax bills are distinct from cash receipts and incentive-program fees.
